description: Amendment register of the frozen Phase 79 saldo-neutrality characterisation (saldo-neutrality-characterisation-79.test.ts). The frozen literals in that file are never edited; a cell whose expected value changed ON PURPOSE is named here and the test applies the register to a deep copy of the frozen literal, checking that every entry's `from` still equals the frozen value. Same mechanism as saldo-boundary-neutrality-493-amendments.json.
